AMAction.doc: An abstract class that defines the interface and general characteristics of Automator actions.

AMAppleScriptAction.doc: An object that represents Automator actions whose runtime behavior is driven by an AppleScript script.

AMBundleAction.doc: An object that represents an Automator action that’s a loadable bundle.

AMShellScriptAction.doc: An object that represents Automator actions whose runtime behavior is driven by a shell script or by a Perl or Python script.

AMWorkflow.doc: An object that lets you use an Automator workflow in your app.

AMWorkflowController.doc: An object that lets you manage an Automator workflow in your app.

AMWorkflowView.doc: An object that lets you view and edit Automator workflows in your app.

AMWorkspace.doc: A workspace for running an Automator workflow.

AMWorkflowControllerDelegate.doc: A set of optional methods that a delegate of a workflow controller implements.

-activated.doc: Allows the action to synchronize its information with settings in another app.

-closed.doc: Invoked by Automator when the receiving action is removed from a workflow, allowing it to perform cleanup operations.

-didFinishRunningWithError:.doc: Sent by the action to itself when it has finished running asynchronously.

-finishRunningWithError:.doc: Causes the action to stop running and return an error, which, in turn, causes the workflow to stop.

-initWithContentsOfURL:error:.doc: Loads an Automator action from a file URL.

-initWithDefinition:fromArchive:.doc: Initializes the action with the specified definition.

-logMessageWithLevel:format:.doc: Displays a message in Automator’s log area.

-opened.doc: Allows the action to initialize its user interface.

-parametersUpdated.doc: Requests the action to update its user interface from its stored parameters, which have changed.

-reset.doc: Resets the action to its initial state.

-runAsynchronouslyWithInput:.doc: Causes Automator to wait for notification that the action has completed execution, which allows the action to perform an asynchronous operation.

-runWithInput:error:.doc: Requests the action to perform its task using the specified input.

-runWithInput:fromAction:error:.doc: Requests the action to perform its task using the specified input from the specified action.

-updateParameters.doc: Requests the action to update its stored set of parameters from the settings in the action’s user interface.

-willFinishRunning.doc: Provides an opportunity for an action to perform cleanup operations, such as closing windows and deallocating memory.

-writeToDictionary:.doc: Examines the parameters and other configuration information specified in the passed dictionary and adds its own information to it if appropriate.

-awakeFromBundle.doc: Allows the action object to perform setup tasks requiring the presence of all bundle objects.

+runWorkflowAtURL:withInput:error:.doc: Loads and runs the specified workflow file.

-addAction:.doc: Adds the specified action at the end of the receiving workflow.

-initWithContentsOfURL:error:.doc: Creates and initializes a workflow based on the contents of the specified file.

-insertAction:atIndex:.doc: Inserts the specified action at the specified position of the receiving workflow.

-moveActionAtIndex:toIndex:.doc: Moves the action from the specified start position to the specified end position in the receiving workflow.

-removeAction:.doc: Removes the specified action from the workflow.

-setValue:forVariableWithName:.doc: Sets the value of the workflow variable with the specified name.

-valueForVariableWithName:.doc: Returns the value of the workflow variable with the specified name.

-writeToURL:error:.doc: Writes the workflow to the specified file.

-reset:.doc: Stops a workflow, clears any action results, and resets the workflow back to an un-run state.

-run:.doc: Runs the associated workflow, after first clearing any results stored by its actions during any previous run.

-step:.doc: In a paused workflow, runs the next action in the workflow and then pauses again.

-runWorkflowAtPath:withInput:error:.doc: Loads and runs the specified workflow file.

ignoresInput.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the action acts upon its input or the input is ignored.

progressValue.doc: A float value between 0 and 1, which indicates how far along the action is while processing.

selectedInputType.doc: The type of input, in UTI format, of the input received by the action.

selectedOutputType.doc: The type of output, in UTI format, of the output to be produced by the action.

stopped.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the user clicked the stop button on the parent workflow.

script.doc: An OSAScript object representing the receiver’s script containing the on run command handler.

hasView.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the action has a view associated with it.

inputFieldSeparator.doc: A string to use as the delimiter between items in the string passed to the action through standard input.

outputFieldSeparator.doc: A string to use as a delimiter in the string output by the action.

remapLineEndings.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether you want automatic remapping of carriage return (\r) to newline (\n) characters in the input string.

actions.doc: An array of the workflow’s actions.

fileURL.doc: A URL that specifies the location of the workflow file.

input.doc: The input data that is passed to the first action in the workflow.

output.doc: The output data that is provided by the last action in the workflow.

canRun.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the controller’s workflow is able to run.

paused.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the controller’s workflow is currently paused.

running.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the controller’s workflow is currently running.

editable.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the workflow view is editable.
